title: F106-family restore object verification depth
canonical_summary: Define the restore drill's object verification as full object-store integrity verification and bind the receipt's object_closure_result to the depth that produced it.
gui_classification_reason: Machine-contract correction to an existing backend obligation; the broader owner PlanUnits keep their own GUI classification.
negative_constraints: Do not admit a connectivity-only or reachability-only pass as object verification.
Do not run the verification on the original repository or while the capture barrier is held.

title: Divergent change representability and refusal
canonical_summary: Make a change with more than one visible commit nameable in the graph projection and refusable before effect, without adding any convergence command.
gui_classification_reason: The rule governs what a person sees or is told on a Source Control surface.
negative_constraints: Do not add an explicit-convergence command; that capability is unapproved.
Do not insert divergent at a graph_states position that shifts an existing frozen value.
Do not admit divergent on a Git page.

title: One shared native toolchain identity and a certification scenario matrix
canonical_summary: Bind the exact jj, adapter, Git and store-format identity to the closure records and the certification profile through one shared block, and give the certification reference a nine-scenario matrix.
gui_classification_reason: Machine-contract correction to an existing backend obligation; the broader owner PlanUnits keep their own GUI classification.
negative_constraints: Do not let an unknown scenario support state stand under an admitted disposition.
Do not let a root certification certify a child layout.
Do not remove the snapshot's existing adapter_version; it is the compatibility alias.

title: Store pointer resolution, its bases and its boundary
canonical_summary: Record every in-store location pointer the capture followed with the base it resolved against and the environment that resolved it, and require the drill to resolve them again inside the isolation boundary.
gui_classification_reason: Machine-contract correction to an existing backend obligation; the broader owner PlanUnits keep their own GUI classification.
negative_constraints: Do not resolve alternates against the Git directory or commondir against the object database.
Do not record raw machine paths in a closure or receipt.
Do not follow a pointer that resolves outside the isolation boundary.

title: A read is proven non-mutating, not declared non-mutating
canonical_summary: Pin every capture and drill read to an exact operation with an ignore-working-copy mode, record the operation-head set before and after, and keep a read-class command off a default mutating native invocation.
gui_classification_reason: Machine-contract correction to an existing backend obligation; the broader owner PlanUnits keep their own GUI classification.
negative_constraints: Do not grant a read any writer, credential, FileSafe, confirmation or interop authority.
Do not add a mutating status refresh branch.
Do not resolve divergence during a read; record it.

title: Machine-local and ephemeral native store entries
canonical_summary: Classify every entry inside the native store tree against the pinned JJ version, never restore a machine-local or ephemeral entry as active state, and make an unrecognized entry yield partial rather than complete.
gui_classification_reason: Machine-contract correction to an existing backend obligation; the broader owner PlanUnits keep their own GUI classification.
negative_constraints: Do not classify a store entry by filename pattern such as *.lock.
Do not invent the enumerated entry list before the source audit is done.
Do not report complete over an unrecognized entry.

title: A held GC fence states what it covered
canonical_summary: Enumerate the writer paths a held GC fence covered with the evidence for each, and make a complete capture admissible only when every known path is covered.
gui_classification_reason: Machine-contract correction to an existing backend obligation; the broader owner PlanUnits keep their own GUI classification.
negative_constraints: Do not cite the withdrawn UNIX_EPOCH op-store GC claim as support for this rule.
Do not report a complete closure while a known writer path is uncovered or unknown.

title: No canonical command reaches an interactive editor session
canonical_summary: Refuse before effect any canonical Jujutsu command whose only expressible native execution would open an interactive diff or merge editor the workbench cannot host.
gui_classification_reason: The rule governs what a person sees or is told on a Source Control surface.
negative_constraints: Do not add a content-selection vocabulary to the command target under this correction; that is an optional capability.
Do not leave such a command nominally available.

title: A blocked repository always admits a way to look
canonical_summary: Require at least the operation log and operation show commands in the allowed action set for the quarantine and staleness reason codes, and require every admitted identifier to exist.
gui_classification_reason: The rule governs what a person sees or is told on a Source Control surface.
negative_constraints: Do not add a command to satisfy the floor; both are already in the frozen inventory.
Do not claim the floor commands are servable from the operation store alone without evidence.

title: Bookmark track and untrack are local mutations
canonical_summary: Reclassify the two bookmark tracking commands from transport mutation to local mutation with a null credential lease, resolving a contradiction inside the shipped fixtures.
gui_classification_reason: Machine-contract correction to an existing backend obligation; the broader owner PlanUnits keep their own GUI classification.
negative_constraints: Do not drop the writer lease, FileSafe decision, permission snapshot, expected-revision fence or remote identity.
Do not reclassify clone, fetch or push.

title: Closure completeness has a decision procedure
canonical_summary: Give closure completeness an expansion procedure with four typed blockers and a dependency-safe materialization order in which heads and activation markers come last.
gui_classification_reason: Machine-contract correction to an existing backend obligation; the broader owner PlanUnits keep their own GUI classification.
negative_constraints: Do not treat a missing parent, malformed id, self-parent or parent cycle as a silent skip.
Do not publish a referring head before its dependency objects.

title: Conflict and merge editor scope on a Jujutsu workspace
canonical_summary: Define merge_editor_available in its owner, scope the diff, merge-editor and external-tool preference surfaces as read-only or built-in-editor-only on a Jujutsu workspace, and give a control disabled by that scoping a typed reason.
gui_classification_reason: The rule governs what a person sees or is told on a Source Control surface.
negative_constraints: Do not let an external merge tool write into a Jujutsu workspace through these surfaces.
Do not record the deferred save-back candidates as declined.
Do not change the Git-adapter scoping of the existing conflict-assistant rows.

title: Bookmark controls disclose the remotes they affect
canonical_summary: Own a five-value bookmark state vocabulary, require every control and confirmation to name the remotes it affects before dispatch, and carry the disclosure on the confirmation record.
gui_classification_reason: The rule governs what a person sees or is told on a Source Control surface.
negative_constraints: Do not share one control between delete-local and forget-remote.
Do not fold an unsynced, untracked or absent reference into a combined chip.
Do not add forget-remote or any other command to the frozen inventory.
Do not present a pseudo-remote or a non-fetchable remote as an ordinary remote.
